message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, 12:00 CT, Cobalt moves to a new core banking system. For those 36 hours the app is read-only: you can see your balance, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards are paused. To thank you for your patience, for the next 4 weeks we add 0.5 points to your savings rate on balances up to $50,000. The switch can run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app.
why:
Half of deposits sit with large-balance savers, and our rate is 0.5 points below the best rivals.
Rivals know the migration date and will advertise that weekend.
Closing the rate gap for 4 weeks covers the weeks around the switch.

message: We know the system move came right after payday. We have added $10 to your account as a thank you. For the next 8 weeks, if you dispute a card charge, we credit up to $100 right away while we investigate.
why:
Paycheck customers felt the freeze most: paid Friday, locked out Saturday.
A concrete credit says sorry without big promises.
Instant dispute credit cuts the complaints most likely to reach the CFPB.
